# time 0 as 0/1 over sites 1..n, wrapped at 100 characters per line (concatenate the lines). Phase 0: column 0
# reads t mod 2 (white at even times); phase 1: (t+1) mod 2. The left half is the forced left half of the clock
# and this right half; it is white at depths d..d+L-1 of row 0, and the whole configuration keeps the clock
# for t = 0..T-1 with T = d+L (checked by forward Rule 30 on the whole finite row, no clamping). Sites beyond n

# Verifier: build the left half by the leftward reading from the clock and column 1 (column 1 from a clamped
# forward run of the right half), then run plain Rule 30 on left+wall+right and read column 0 and row 0.
